verdict.rationale: Datalab publishes a structured per-endpoint API reference (convert-document, extract-structured-data, segment-document, run-document-agent, api-health, and others). Nothing in the evidence shows those pages are interactive or offer runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404. The Forge playground lets users try document processing in a UI without an API key, but it is not an API reference console. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console in the API reference, runnable request examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
